summary: Nez Perce National Forest lookout staffed since 1920, rebuilt as an L-4 cab in 1951, damaged in a 2015 fire, and restaffed by 2022.

access.note: Drive-up access; staffed Forest Service lookout.

events.note: Tent camp with observation points along the ridge.
Cabin and 50-foot pole tower with 7x7 cab built; cabin still used for storage.
Current L-4 cab on 41-foot treated timber tower built, replacing the pole tower.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register April 6, 2009.
Damaged by the Wash Fire; lookout Kris Anderson evacuated early in the season.
John Crawford staffed the lookout from 1976 to 2008.
Bob Zimmerman staffed the lookout from 2009 to 2010.
Lawrence Gilley staffed the lookout from 2011 to 2013.
John Crawford returned and staffed the tower through 2024.

evidence.quote: 1928 – 50′ Pole tower with 7’x7′ cab and cabin living quarters (cabin still used for storage today)
1951 – L-4 Cab on 41′ treated timber tower.
1937–1941 Mr. Thomas Morris (Former Forest Fire Lookout Registry)

evidence.supports: Kris Anderson 2014-2015, evacuated due to Wash Fire
evidence.quote: 2014–2015 Kris Anderson — Came down early in 2015 due to the Wash Fire

evidence.supports: closed roughly five years after Wash Fire damage
evidence.quote: It was the closed after the wash fire due to fire damage for five years. Now staffed by Corey Nease.

evidence.supports: NHLR registration date and 1951 built date
1951 tower, threatened by Slims Fire 2003, damaged 2015
evidence.quote: The present 41' treated timber tower with L-4 cab was built in 1951, and is staffed every summer. It was threatened by the Slims fire in 2003. The tower was damaged during a 2015 forest fire.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and firelookout.com date the current structure to 1951, while idahofirelookouts.com describes the same 1951 L-4 cab build; the 1929/1930 log cabin mentioned on NHLR appears to be an earlier structure not captured in idahofirelookouts.com's 1920/1928 timeline, likely the same early period described differently.

sources.title: Comment on Indian Hill Lookout page

notes_for_editor: Fact-check pass 2026-10-04: the original research omitted John Crawford's 1976-2008 staffing stint, which idahofirelookouts.com's known-staff list actually gives in full (1976-2008 Crawford, 2009-2010 Zimmerman, 2011-2013 Gilley, 2014-2015 Anderson, 2022-2024 Crawford again); the story previously implied Crawford's 2022 return was his only tenure. Corrected in both files. The 1929 log-cabin build year on NHLR versus the 1928 cabin/pole-tower date on idahofirelookouts.com may refer to the same construction episode.
